shared_elements: low-relief incised linear detail on a body
curved bands / drapery-like lines across the torso or lower body
justification: Both depict an anthropomorphic figure whose body carries incised curved bands and roughly circular motifs, but this is about as generic as figural carving gets. A shows a naturalistic profile figure's draped lower body over a horizontal band of many-petalled rosettes, while B shows a frontal/rear-view blocky figure with a head and schematic ring and crescent devices scattered over the back — different proportions, viewpoint conventions, and no shared specific motif combination.
